response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT s.entrystat, e.ambictemp, e.imgcount FROM scanenvironment e JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = e.zoneref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(imgcount) AS avg_imgcount_all FROM matched) SELECT m.entrystat, AVG(m.ambictemp) AS avg_ambictemp, AVG(m.imgcount) AS avg_imgcount, AVG(m.imgcount) - o.avg_imgcount_all AS imgcount_diff_from_overall FROM matched m CROSS JOIN overall o GROUP BY m.entrystat, o.avg_imgcount_all;

assumptions.assumption: The join is an inner join on scanenvironment.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry, so environment records without a matching site are dropped.
The overall image average is taken over all matched environment records (after the join) with non-null imgcount, using AVG, which ignores NULLs.
Records with a NULL entrystat form their own group, since SQL GROUP BY treats NULL as one group. The request does not say whether they should be kept or dropped.
